releases.name: FlyKnight
releases.summary:
Flyknight tells the tale of a squire of the order of the Flyknights who is assembled to vanquish the witch Lunamoth and lift her curse, which is preventing the denizens of the realm from growing wings. 

Now separated after an ambush, the squire arriveth at the village of the swamp folk and pledges to see the mission through, either alone or teaming up with other fighters summoned to help along the way.

Do you have what it takes to emerge victorious and claim Knighthood?

releases.name: Parables of Jesus
releases.summary: Designed for beginning readers, grades K-3, these sentence puzzles move into place to create beautiful, engaging photos. Puzzle themes include transportation, animals, birds, ocean life and sports.  More than 50 puzzles to do!Need help?  Tap the wizard and the puzzle solves itself.

releases.name: Frog Parkour Obby
releases.summary:
Play as a frog and take on a colorful parkour obstacle course filled with moving platforms, powerful jump pads, dangerous traps, and tricky jumps. Reach the end of each level and prove your parkour skills.

Looking for a tougher challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake sends you all the way back.

releases.name: Paper Airplane Flying Game
releases.summary: ZASAWORD IS A FUN AND ADDICTIVE TWIST ON PUZZLE WORD GAMES!*** FREE FOR A LIMITED TIME! ***Zasaword not only challenges your word creation skills, but your finger speed as well!You will need to be quick as random letters appear in the "Bag".  Grab the letters and arrange them on the "Rack" to form words.  Submit as many words as you can before time runs out!Similar to Scrabble, each letter has a value.  Letter selection, letter location and word length are all keys to achieving high scores!  Wildcards are available to help you complete words.  You can also utilize the "Storage" area to save letters for later use.  All are part of your word formation strategy!Beat your own high score or see how you rank against everyone else on Game Center!Game Modes- Speed Rounds: Go for the highest score you can in a quick round.- Long Word Challenge: Start by making a word that is exactly 3 letters long, then 4 letters long, and so on.- Arcade: Submitting words increases the time remaining as well as the score.

releases.name: Tales of Formentera
releases.summary: Lost Antz is a fun filled adventure game where you (Ant) have to roam around the dark & unknown under-ground searching for the exit portal.Collect diamonds as much as you can along the path to gain high score. Sounds easy but that's not all, you will have to get away from the angry worms that are roaming around the areas as well. Your health will be degraded once in contact with them.In order to heal, you will have to find the herbal leaves that lies around the area & consume them before its too late. To make playing experience more interesting & adventurous, you will have to dig through the dark under ground in order to see all of the above. You will encounter surprise visits from the worms & finding diamonds will be more interesting!After each successful level play, the play area will be bigger which means more diamonds & leaves to be explored while more worms to be avoided. This surely add more challenge as the level increases.But again that's not all! Diamonds, leaves & worms are located randomly around the play area each time playing. This means that if you are playing level 1 again & again, the diamonds, leaves & worms location will be different each time! This surely adds the mystery & fun while playing this game each time.What's more? If you feel that it is too difficult to gain high score, there are some cool super powers that you can utilize via in-App purchase.Super Shoes - this will boost your speed while moving around. You can get away faster from the worms for sure with this cool shoes.Super Space - this will make your path around you bigger as you move. This surely improves visibility as you can see better what's in front, left or right while moving.Super Sonic (Single or Triple) - this cool super power will enable you to shoot sonic boom in front of you & all path straight ahead will be cleared  up to the end of the road thus you can see what lies beneath! Single means you can use once per level & triple means 3 use per level. Superb!Diamond Detector - this will make diamonds around you to emerged automatically so you can see them easily while moving around thus increase your collection efficiency.Worm Detector - this will make worms around you to emerged automatically thus you can avoid them fast before they are in contacts with you!NOTES : Kindly address any technical issues or queries to info@push.my & we appreciate your comments, suggestions or bug reports. Please spare some time to rate this game in the App Store.Enjoy!

releases.name: Dice A Million
releases.summary: Try to count more sheeps as your friends or other people all around the earth.The goal is to count all the sheeps that are in the barn.If you think you achieved a new record you should press the submit button in the upper right corner.On the next step you have to enter the number of sheeps that were in the barn.If you entered the correct number you could submit your score.There are five different highscores:- daily highscore- weekly highscore- monthly highscore- all global highscore- facebook highscoreIn the facebook highscore can you see how many sheeps your friends already counted.Have fun with this simple but hopefully addicting app.Really nice to play with friends and bet who counts the most.The little sheeps are so cute and want to go in the barn because it is getting cold outside.If you have any suggestions or questions write us:support@nextwebgeneration.deIt is a game similiar to tamago because you have to stay as long as possible and concentrate.

releases.name: Fortress Merge
releases.summary: Merge buildings, upgrade your defenses, and protect your fortress from endless waves of zombies. Plan each move carefully, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

releases.name: Order Automatica
releases.summary:
Order Automatica is a dark tactical roguelite where automated battles are won before they even begin.

Build deadly synergies on a small 3x3 ritual grid, position your units carefully, manipulate tiles, and prepare for brutal encounters against demonic enemies. Every move matters.

releases.name: Isle of Reveries
releases.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

releases.name: 4096 Space Traders Era
releases.summary: Quickly and easily roll dice for your favorite table top role playing games.  RPG Dice Pro is a must have for any RPG gamer.Enter 3d20= (press '3', 'd20', and '=') to roll and sum 3 twenty-sided dice.  Or use a more complicated expression (e.g., 2d10 + 2d6 - 5 =).Support all standard dice (d2, d3, d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100) as well as any other custom dice.Built-in calculator lets you quickly calculate damage, attack, or any other game values.  Individual rolls are shown for rolls of 8 dice or less.  This makes it easy to check for criticals.Quick re-roll by tapping = again.  Or hit RCL to get a list of all the previous rolls to re-roll.

releases.name: Asdivine Knot
releases.summary:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises - until the truth shattered everything he believed. 

When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. 

Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

releases.name: Horse Spirit Valley
releases.summary: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—with Steam achievements to chase along the way.

releases.name: Alluring Neon Night Town
releases.summary: Cupid's Carnage brings you the greatest carnage series of all-time! The game features pop-star Guinevere as the soundtrack to the perfect revenge game. releases.name: Superstar Strategy
releases.summary:
Outfight and outwit your enemies in this turn-based tactics game. Use each unit's unique abilities and the terrain around you to your advantage to thwart your opponent's plans and reign supreme!

Push, pull, teleport, and displace your enemies onto traps to deal additional damage and apply status effects between rounds. If you are able to escape the trap before the new round starts, you can cheat fate!

With 14 different unit roles to choose from, you can create your own unique combinations to build your own personal army! Experiment with different units to find synergies and force multipliers to improve your chances of victory.

releases.name: Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap
releases.summary: Thor the Viking is really hungry. Help him eat by getting all the hamburgers nearby. Beware of the skulls and the evil gifts that appear though.

releases.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Boys Dating Sim
releases.summary:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three men who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what he is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls him closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and he lets something slip he's never told anyone. Push too hard and he's gone before you can fix it.

Three men. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.
